title: The dashboard inventory figure keeps an untracked part's stock
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL DASHBOARD LOC), a location created for this case that holds only this case's part, so its figures come from that part alone.
  • Bin {Bin-A} is the default bin of {Location-A} (for example General Storage), the bin New Inventory Part fills in.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-DASH-01) is active and tracked at {Location-A}, with 6 in {Bin-A} at a cost of $10.00 ($60.00 of stock).
  • The Dashboard at {Location-A} shows an inventory figure {Dashboard-figure-A} of $60.00 before the steps start.
  • The Dashboard refreshes its figures about once an hour, so the steps include a wait.
custom_steps:
1. Search the part number of {Part-A} in Parts → Inventory and click its row.
  2. Click the Track quantities and cost of goods switch so it is off.
  3. Click Save.
  4. Wait about 70 minutes.
  5. Open the Dashboard at {Location-A} and read the inventory figure.
  6. Open Reports → Inventory Value with the Location filter on {Location-A} only and the as-of date on today.
  7. Read the Totals row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Steps 1 to 7: The opening inventory used for accounting has no screen; this part cannot be checked by hand; write "not checked by hand" in the result comment.
  • Step 5: The Dashboard figure still reads $60.00, the same as {Dashboard-figure-A}: the untracked part's stock is kept.
  • Step 7: The Inventory Value report shows Total Cost $0.00 with no rows: the report leaves the part out while the Dashboard keeps it.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10817 (Story 4, Create an Untracked Part); story SV-10818 (Story 5, Change Tracking on an Existing Part); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), §2 Feature Overview, Accounting, read 13 Oct 2026. Tech plan 7 Oct 2026, Phase 4 (no tracking filter on the dashboard's stock figures or the accounting opening inventory). Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • PRD §2 Accounting: “The dashboard's inventory figure and the opening inventory used for accounting keep untracked parts, because that stock still sits in the books.”
  • PRD §2 Accounting: “The Inventory Value report leaves out untracked parts, because they keep no stock count to value. This is a report change only.”
  • Tech plan Phase 4: “The PRD's Accounting section keeps untracked parts in all of them.”
